product.description:
The Green Chile Bible: Award-Winning New Mexico Recipes

A collection of New Mexico green chile recipes compiled and edited by The Albuquerque Tribune. The photographed pages include traditional favorites and New Mexican posole.

Condition

Used paperback with light cover marks, edge/corner wear and slight cover curling. Handwritten travel inscription on the half-title page and handwritten recipe note on page 87, as photographed. The book has not been inspected page by page; additional marks may be present. Please review all photographs.

Details

  • Compiled and edited by The Albuquerque Tribune.
  • Clear Light Publishers, Santa Fe, New Mexico. Copyright 1994.
  • Copyright page states First Edition; the number line ends in 2. This is not represented as a first printing.
  • English-language paperback.
  • ISBN 0940666359 / 9780940666351.

Included

One paperback cookbook, exactly as photographed.

Packing & Shipping

Protected against cover and edge damage and packed securely in a rigid box. Buyer-paid calculated USPS Media Mail shipping. Returns accepted within 30 days; buyer pays return shipping.
